description: Returns Aidoptio's public register of vendor relations (the content of /.well-known/disclosures.json: fees received from vendors, resale, each relation with its category, status and default rule), the six rules of the independence policy in the chosen language, and the URLs of the policy, the machine-readable register and the public method log. Relations without a public name are listed by category only and confirmed per name, in writing, in a proposal. The policy is a draft that has not been legally reviewed yet (see policy_status).

lang.description: Language of the returned text: en (English, default) or nl (Dutch).

name: get_disclosures
title: Get Aidoptio's vendor relations and independence rules
